pages.reviewNotes: Audited FY2025 consolidated IFRS statements pp. 124 and 127: SEK million revenue 46,021, operating profit 4,675, owner earnings 3,429 and owner equity 19,897. The total result including non-controlling interests was 3,436. The share section p. 11 reports a closing price of SEK 263.80, 260,451,002 shares and market capitalisation SEK 68,706m. Multiplying the quoted share count and rounded price gives SEK 68,706.97m. Wisdom's pretax profit matches the report, but its EBIT is SEK 219m lower, with an equal difference in net financial income; the source-line mapping requires further investigation.

pages.sourceNote: Revenue includes rental and service income. Operating profit is not separately reported. Market capitalisation is the company’s approximate year-end amount for both listed share classes.
pages.reviewNotes: Audited FY2025 consolidated IFRS statements pp. 33–34: SEK million total rental and service income 128.148 (rental income 125.827 plus other income 2.321), owner earnings 59.966 and owner equity 558.811. Note 5 on p. 44 says other income includes charged management fees and other income outside the lease agreements. The report does not present a separately identified operating profit; the standard XBRL candidate 29.104 is the company’s förvaltningsresultat, which includes net finance expenses. The previously displayed 51.647 resembles the property operating surplus less central administration, but excludes later income statement items. Page 27 reports SEK 10.50 as the year-end closing price of the B share and an approximate SEK 456m market capitalisation for both listed share classes.
